headline: Missouri-St. Louis wins on as McKendree falls
dek: Missouri-St. Louis answered their defeat at Maryville by beating Saginaw Valley State and Findlay without conceding, and have let in thirteen goals all season. McKendree, the only other side with sixteen wins, lost to Wayne State.
displaced_by: Missouri-St. Louis beat Saginaw Valley State and Findlay after the Maryville defeat; McKendree lost to Wayne State
